mddom.name: Magdeburg Cathedral
mddom.slogan: Two spires, 800 years, and an emperor asleep in the choir.
mddom.line: Work on the cathedral began in 1209; the steeples, 99 and 101 metres tall, were only finished in 1520.

mdzitadelle.name: Green Citadel
mdzitadelle.slogan: Hundertwasser's pink-and-gold block with trees growing from the roof.
mdzitadelle.line: Hundertwasser died in 2000; the Green Citadel, one of his last projects, was completed in 2005 with 55 apartments.

mdtrogbruecke.name: Magdeburg Water Bridge
mdtrogbruecke.slogan: Ships sail over the Elbe instead of down into it.
mdtrogbruecke.line: At 918 metres, it is Europe's longest canal bridge, opened in 2003 after work stopped in 1942.

mdreiter.name: Magdeburg Rider
mdreiter.slogan: A crowned horseman on Alter Markt who may ride at midnight.
mdreiter.line: Carved around 1240, it is one of the earliest free-standing, life-size equestrian statues of the Middle Ages.

mdtangerrathaus.name: Tangermünde Town Hall
mdtangerrathaus.slogan: Three red-brick gables rising over a quiet Elbe town.
mdtangerrathaus.line: Built in the 1430s, its three stepped gables mark Tangermünde's brick-Gothic golden age.
